what: On first open, the wordmark stands at mid-screen height. Each letter cell unfolds horizontally from 0 → 1 with a .058s offset (.29s, curve M0,0 C0.8,0 0.833,0.833 1,1). .29s after unfolding, the rounded bars morph into their letter shapes (MorphSVG .44s, M0,0 C0.167,0.167 0.2,1 1,1 — letters with an inner piece like O rotate along and stand up at -45°). Once everything has morphed, the wordmark rises into the header logo spot over 1s power3.inOut. The backing plate folds up around its top edge (scaleY 0, .5s) and clears, then fires fx:done. Plays only once per window (session)

options.to: Selector of the element the wordmark rises to sit on — it goes to that element’s vertical position. If none, the head height at the top of the panel (--fx-head, default 3.875rem)
options.each · grow · morph · rise: Letter spacing · spread · shape change · rise durations (s), default .058 · .29 · .44 · 1
options.every: if visit, plays every time it opens, default session
options.--fx-bg · --fx-ink: Board · text color (via style), default var(--kf-bg) · var(--kf-ink)
options.[data-fx-part=letter]: Character cell <g> — inside [data-fx-part=from](start type) and [data-fx-part=to] (end shape, hidden) two paths. [data-fx-part=Wrap spin] and that group rotates starting at -45°

note: Load MorphSVGPlugin (free GSAP plugin) first. Without it, there is no shape morph and it just swaps to the end shape. In the original the header menu comes in while the panel clears, which the consuming side hooks to fx:done or the same 1.1s point

from.where: index.html .an-preloader (”LOGOTYPE” eight letters · original home.js preloader — smilScaleEase·smilMorphEase · logo·menu dots rise to the header)
